contract: Preserve YAML keys, values, comments, ordering, types, aliases, tags, cssclasses, and unknown or nested data; only explicitly approved property value spans may change.

fixture_coverage.coverage: Ordered typed projection for scalars, arrays, nested mappings/sequences, cssclasses and unknown keys; aliases, tags, malformed flow syntax and block scalars remain source-only with explicit issues; source bytes and no-op round-trip remain identical.
A title edit changes only its approved byte span while BOM, CRLF, comments, ordering, aliases, tags, typed values, nested content and unknown top-level fields remain exact.
Block and flow keys/indices edit only the selected leaf; comments and siblings remain exact; malformed, unsupported, ambiguous, missing and structured paths fail closed.

focused_tests.result: All four focused tests and the full Rust workspace test suites passed on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows. GitHub job logs contain each focused test's passing line on every platform.

ci.result: All seven required workflows passed on this exact implementation SHA.

limitations: Aliases, tags, block scalars, malformed YAML and excessive nesting remain explicitly source-only or unsupported; their original bytes remain authoritative.
This acceptance covers the document/property contract and does not claim a structured properties UI or full Markdown dialect rendering.
local_validation: None. Tests and executable validation ran only in GitHub Actions.
